section.p: Figure 10 shows the Health Index Historical Data as a scatter plot generated by analysing the data received from the SMS by the ADI OtoSense™ Server.

ul.li: The scatter plot’s X-axis shows the 1-10 scale of the Health Index.
The scatter plot’s Y-axis shows all dates between 01 September 2024 and 10 November 2024.

li.p: The placeholder icon is a data point for the Performance parameter of the motor.
You can analyse the clusters and outliers to better understand the underlying issues.
For example, data points that fall below 5 on the health index should be further analysed and appropriate action should be taken.
